item.text: [{"task_id":"db3e9e38","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    seed = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    alternate = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    spread = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    period = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    direction = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    out = grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == seed)","    if len(points) == 0 or period <= 0 or spread <= 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    bottom = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","    center = int(points[0, 1])","    for r in range(grid.shape[0]):","        distance = direction * (r - bottom)","        if r >= top and distance >= 0:","            for c in range(grid.shape[1]):","                offset = abs(c - center)","                if offset <= distance * spread:","                    if offset % period == 0:","                        out[r, c] = seed","                    else:","                        out[r, c] = alternate","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[7,8,1,2,-1]},"rationale":"Expand the vertical orange line into an upward triangle anchored at its bottom endpoint, widening by one cell on each side per row.
